findings.statement: Approval concerns the native subject's bounded planning reassessment, not the universal hive-equidecomposability claim. Stopping this particular negative search asserts no mathematical exhaustion. Continuing with the seed construction is supported by the delivered explicit inequalities, shear and lattice target: it addresses the missing geometric rearrangement rather than repeating the unsuccessful polynomial test.
